title: Person: Brother Michael
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Brother Michael

anchor.prefix:
t.

 —Ah, do! he said.

 —Butter you up! said Brother Michael. You’ll get your walking papers in the morning when the doctor comes.

 —Will I? the fellow said. I’m not well yet.
anchor.suffix:
repeated:

 —You’ll get your walking papers. I tell you.

 He bent down to rake the fire. He had a long back like the long back of a tramhorse. He shook the poker gravely and nodd
